# Fixture: decision-benefit juxtaposition pattern (mitigated)

In November, the board decided to authorize the asset transfer. The directors moved to approve it without further review. The record does not establish whether any director knew, at the time of approval, who the eventual purchaser would be.

By December, Cole Industries had acquired the parcels for a fraction of the assessed value. The same directors profited from the sale to the secondary buyer the following spring; benefit accrued through the directors' separate holdings, though whether benefit motivated the original approval is not in the record.
